risk_summary: The excerpt provides substantial quantitative disclosure, but extensive forward-looking-statement disclaimers and broad non-exhaustive risk language reduce specificity regarding future outcomes. Risk tone is moderately negative, reflecting declining earnings, weak power prices, asset impairments, plant deactivations, labor disruption, and nuclear-plant cracking, although management presents mitigation and repositioning actions.
